How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when we
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases

Our Oversized Sweatshirt, featuring an oversized silhouette is easy to dress up or down. Clean-cut from our 100% Organic Cotton Fleece-back fabric and features an Applique Patch Varsity Logo. To get the laid-back athleisure look, style with the matching sweatpants, perfect for lounging or coffee dates.


→ 100% Organic Cotton Fleece-back
→ 420GSM medium weight
→ Applique Adanola Sport varsity logo

 

How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting, inside out - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when wet
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases

→ 420gsm medium weight
→ Applique Adanola Sport varsity logo

 

Take good care of me:
→ Wash inside out, on a gentle setting
→ Wash cold
→ Wash by hand if possible
→ Do not tumble dry or dry at high temperatures
→ Lay flat to dry
→ Reshape while damp
→ Do not overload washing machine
→ Ironing once dry will help regain softness of fabric

Please note that our coffee bean sweats may vary in colour very slightly to any of your previously purchased Adanola, this is due to the continual production of this fabric.

products.title: Classic ADA Oversized Sweatshirt - Damson Red
products.body_html:
The ADA Sweatshirt features an oversized silhouette, crafted from our Classic heavyweight 100% organic cotton for a premium look and feel. Finished with our signature appliqué ADA logo across the chest. Thoughtfully developed with an updated fit and made from a high-quality fabric, it's designed to become an everyday essential. Complete your look by pairing it with the matching sweatpants.


→ 100% Organic Cotton
→ 440 GSM heavy weight fabric 
→ ADA embroidered logo on centre chest
→ Oversized fit


How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when wet
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases

Finished with a signature branded badge on the chest and practical zipped pockets to keep your everyday essentials close. Pair it with the Ultimate Leggings for an effortless everyday look.


→ 100% Recycled Polyester
→ Contrast coffee bean panels detail
→ Branded rubber badge on chest pocket
→ Zip on pockets
→ Branded buttons


Take good care of me:
